subject: general
question: Who headed the Commission appointed in April 2007 to suggest measures for improvement in centre-state relations in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**M.M. Punchhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **M.M. Punchhi** headed the Commission appointed in April 2007.
 
• The Commission was tasked with suggesting measures for the improvement of **centre-state relations** in India.
 
• The Commission is commonly referred to as the **Punchhi Commission**.
 
•
